text: Nadia R.: Orion Systems reported intermittent segfaults in their marketplace image running batched 4-bit quant models. Seen on our preflight and customer smoke. Stack: NVIDIA driver 540.x + CUDA 12.3, mixed-precision kernels. Jonah M.: Repro command from partner: `./run_infer --model redwood/quant4 --batch 8 --tokens 2048 --iters 300` 10 fails around iter 150-210. Ravi S.: I can reproduce on their image in our SI lab. Crash trace points to gpu memcpy path in our runtime when KV cache wraps. Devon W.: Quick triage: toggling continuous KV caching off avoids the crash; reducing tokens helps. Hypothesis: driver+cuda12.3 path selects a new memcpy kernel that mishandles overlapped copies under heavy reuse. Nadia R.: Orion has a press demo Friday. They prefer we provide a pinned image recommendation vs delaying. Proposed short plan: 1) Ask Orion to publish `orion-nvidia-pinned-530` (NVIDIA 530 + CUDA 12.1) 2) Run partner SI regression + short perf (iters=300) 3) If green, allow demo with pinned image and note guidance 4) Parallel: eng-runtime investigate memcpy guard/backoff for next patch. Devon W.: I'll open a runtime PR to add a memcpy sanity check and a runtime flag `--kv-memguard` for canary rollout. Ravi S.: I'll coordinate partner image cut and request their CI logs. ops-bot: release created: `orion-nvidia-pinned-530` -> build-20260325. Jonah M.: Running evals now; ETA ~4hrs. Nadia R.: Action items summarized: - Ravi: partner image + confirm demo hold - Jonah: run SI regression and perf smoke - Devon: PR for memcpy guard + canary plan - All: post go/no-go here by 16:00 PT. Keep updates short for partner execs. :eyes:
